steps: Navigate with Tab from the skip link through tenant, principal, campaign, and submit controls.
Load the PostgreSQL snapshot and connect a header-authenticated SSE stream with a stale retention cursor.
Allocate a voucher with Enter and wait for the authoritative campaign snapshot refresh.
Capture the operator secret in memory, verify the password input is cleared, and reach allowed actions with Tab.
Open the confirmation dialog, cancel with Escape, and verify focus restoration.
Confirm pause with Enter, advance the revision externally, then submit the stale end form.
Verify the 412 handler refreshes the authoritative snapshot and revision before retrying end.
Inspect DOM, storage, cookie, and URL surfaces for the raw operator secret and capture the final screenshot.

checks.name: skip link is first keyboard target
SSE is snapshot first and retention reset is announced
ACTIVE state skips disabled activate and reaches pause
operator secret is cleared from password input
Escape cancels and restores action focus
external revision advance prepared stale form
final destructive action completes from refreshed revision
operator secret is absent from DOM storage cookie and URL
